about_the_game: Step into the dazzling streets of 1950s Salem, a city of towering lights and whispered spells, where glamour masks danger, and magic simmers beneath the surface of modernity. Dakota, the daughter of a Salem witch, returns to her hometown after receiving a mysterious letter about her mother’s death. Attacked by a shadowy figure, Dakota finds herself mortally wounded and trapped between the world of the living and the spirit realm. Guided by her mother’s friend Sebille, Dakota discovers her magical abilities and learns the killer is hunting witches across Salem. As a ghost, Dakota uncovers dark rituals, confronts vengeful spirits, and pieces together the attacker's identity. With her body lying in a hospital bed, her soul journeys into Salem’s most haunted places. Will Dakota harness her newfound powers, save her coven, and return to the living - or will she be consumed by the shadows?
